summary.text: Terry Rice is a Republican member of the Arkansas Senate for District 5.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists House service in the 2009, 2011 and 2013 sessions and Senate service from 2015, and gives Rice's occupation as owner of Rice Furniture & Appliance, Inc.
According to the Senate biography, Rice was elected to the Senate in 2014 after six years in the Arkansas House of Representatives.
Rice was born in Fort Smith and is co-owner of Rice Furniture in Waldron, according to the biography.
